en: A black‑and‑white view of a small European town with narrow streets and stone houses with steep, tiled roofs. In the foreground is a simple bridge or walkway over a narrow stream, lined with railings and fences. People can be seen in the distance along the street. In the background, on a wooded hillside, stands a large fortress‑like building or castle with multiple windows, steep roofs, and small turrets, giving a dominant presence over the village below. There is no visible printed caption or writing on the image side.
